definition: A benchmark sequence string; a terminal run of X denotes placeholder positions for which no concrete residue was retained in the benchmark object.
analysis_rule: X is not imputed and is not treated as a resolved amino-acid identity.

definition: Gold-side sequence field in the aligned-prediction table; uses the same terminal-X placeholder convention as Final_Tested_Sequence.
analysis_rule: Compared literally for sequence-exact summaries; no trailing placeholder residues are added to predictions.

definition: Predicted or source-side sequence in the benchmark prediction tables.
analysis_rule: A missing concrete residue is not inferred from X positions or from neighboring rows.

definition: Exact string agreement between the released gold and prediction sequence fields.
analysis_rule: A terminal-X placeholder mismatch counts as a mismatch; sequence exactness describes agreement with the released benchmark strings, not recovery of withheld or unretained residues.

definition: The production FBBP-DB protein records in tables/proteins.csv.
affected_records: 0 of 1,996 final database records contain X
analysis_rule: The benchmark placeholder convention does not apply to production FBBP-DB sequences.
